content.title: About
content.content: Coffee Latte Nonfat Flavored is a ready‑to‑drink beverage made from espresso, nonfat milk, and natural flavorings. It combines the strength of coffee, the creamy texture of latte, and a light fruit or vanilla note while containing virtually no fat.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Latte comes from the Italian word “latte,” meaning “milk.”
Nonfat milk retains most of the protein and calcium but almost no fat.
Flavorings are often derived from natural extracts of berries, vanilla, or caramel.
Latte is frequently served in large glasses to highlight the balance between coffee and milk.
In many countries, low‑fat latte versions are popular among calorie‑conscious consumers.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Coffee provides polyphenols that help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: Caffeine in coffee enhances alertness and concentration.

items.title: Calcium source
items.content: Nonfat milk maintains a high calcium level important for bone health.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The lack of fat makes the drink suitable for low‑calorie diets.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Coffee contains vitamins B2 and B3, which support energy metabolism.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Some individuals may experience anxiety, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat after caffeine.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Coffee can increase stomach acidity, which may be problematic for gastritis sufferers.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: People allergic to casein should choose dairy‑free alternatives.

items.title: Additive content
items.content: Certain flavorings may contain artificial sweeteners that are not suitable for everyone.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Consume the beverage cold or warmed, adding ice for hot weather. You can also sprinkle cinnamon or cocoa powder on top to enhance the flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, it is best consumed within 7‑10 days, or keep refrigerated for longer freshness.
